positionChange.title: Change position
positionChange.intro: Promotions, transfers and corrections are dated and kept in the history. Payroll pays from the new position and salary from the date.
positionChange.effectiveHint: Today or earlier, after payroll that is already approved.
positionChange.salaryHint: Current {{ amount }} {{ basis }}. Leave empty to keep it.
positionChange.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Annual review, new team lead
positionChange.nothing: Pick a new position, department or salary.
positionChange.historyHint: Promotions, transfers and other changes, newest first.
positionChange.lockedHint: Changed with Change position on the employee page, so it is dated and kept in the history.
